interface.longDescription: Character-first Zodiac sticker-video workflow with semantic V4 visuals, story-object composition and Job@5 handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use skills/zodiac-video-pipeline/SKILL.md and active manifests. Exactly three phases. New Zodiac uses ONLY character_deconstruction as Story Shape; micro_story and hybrid_deconstruction are forbidden as Story Shapes, but scenes/dialogue remain devices within Character. Delivery B Friendly Gossip may be very sharp and dynamic. Preserve evidence, genuine receipts, user approvals and approved Narration; Story Spine precedes Viral hook optimization. Only topic-banter spans omit native V4 environment. Phase 02 Publish Prep follows references/publish-virality.md: distinct spoken hook, SEO title, short cover hook, caption and relevant hashtags. Fresh content targets 90–120s including pauses; measured timing belongs to runner. Story Quality Gate must pass before hook polish and user Content Review; no fake QC approvals. Preserve Job@5 producer/runner boundaries. Never mark runtime QA PASS without actual runner evidence. GitHub changes do not auto-sync to installed ChatGPT plugin. For new 2.4.16+ Story Object plans, author per-beat presentation_mode thought_metaphor, physical_interaction, or visual_cutaway; object does NOT replace background. Read references/story-object-composition-v2.md; run native composition QC before Visual Review and Phase03 release. No Job@5 or renderer schema changes. New covers MUST read references/cover-composition-v2.md, author token-derived cover.design and validate cover design before Visual Review; actual shadows and final PNG are local runner responsibilities. At the Phase01-to-Phase02 boundary run orchestration/phase02-transition-gate.mjs on real source and follow orchestration/b1-entry-policy.md. SOURCE_READY, AUTHORING_REQUIRED and AUTHORING_READY are not native PASS; never invent approvals or empty authoring files. For new releases read orchestration/review-creative-and-publish.md and run audit-visual-story-roles.mjs after visual authoring; do not equate REVIEW_REQUIRED or native contracts with creative/runtime PASS. Run assess-revision-impact.mjs before carrying an approval across revised narration/assets/events/publish data. For runner integration read orchestration/runner-parity-acceptance.md; keep plugin source separate from GitHub and do not claim video PASS based on CI or ZIP-only tests. For local runner acceptance use runner-parity-acceptance.md; measured scene gap, IR lineage, three temporal Remotion frames and media acceptance are post-ZIP gates and never producer ZIP prerequisites. Before Phase03 seal, run orchestration/phase02-evidence-audit.mjs and require genuine state/operations/capability receipts and Visual Review, then run the strict native state validator. Never fabricate evidence or mark audit-ready as PASS. Before Visual Review run visual-story audit for repeated layout, decorative Story Object and effect lifecycle; qualitative mute-test requires actual frames and human review; no metadata-only aesthetic PASS. For manifest step completion, use orchestration/commit-phase02-step.mjs with actual capability receipts and gate evidence; it checks output bytes, operations and strict state validator atomically. Never advance step via chat-only PASS or invent a capability proof. When Phase02 lacks authoring inputs, create a substantive agent-authored four-part payload based on approved narration, then run orchestration/write-phase02-authoring.mjs --workspace ... --payload ...; never let a DRAFT or empty payload count as native authoring ready. This writer persists actual agent decisions, never synthesizes creative decisions itself. Phase03 production must run the strict Phase02 Seal Gate again before staging ZIP; stale/bypassed locks cannot replace genuine manifest and native execution evidence. Reject skeletal authoring plans: production@2.0, semantic fit decisions, visual grammar @1 with every scene, and character assembly @2 must be materially authored before write-phase02-authoring; no placeholder plan can pass the authoring writer. For optional dimensional backgrounds in Phase02, read references/depth-background-system.md. Author .authoring/depth-composition-plan.json based on approved scene intent, run compile-depth-composition.mjs AFTER native environment compilation and BEFORE Scene Direction, run validate-depth-composition.mjs and repeat after source revision. Five V4 palettes and 8 contextual presets; never substitute Story Object, use random palette, invent full-canvas background images or claim depth QC without authored native entities and real frames. When Phase02 uses a depth-composition plan, invoke orchestration/phase02-execute-with-depth.mjs --workspace <path> --run rather than manually calling phase02-execute. The wrapper runs source transition, native environment, depth layers, depth validator, then the existing native coordinator; any failure blocks the phase without fabricated receipts. CONTEXT BUDGET: before each manifest step run orchestration/plan-step-context.mjs for the exact phase/step and active flags; load required references only for the current step, preserve mandatory receipts/validators and review gates. Do not load all Phase02 contracts or previous video packages upfront. Condense state handoff to source hashes, approval IDs and unresolved issues; re-read the primary file only when required. Context selection is advisory and cannot waive any required capability. CONTEXT RESUME: use read-only orchestration/context-capsule.mjs for short state handoffs. Conditional flags must be explicit; context plans cannot waive validators or approvals. SINGLE-SOURCE SCENE CONTEXT: use orchestration/derive-scene-context.mjs only for bounded scene references when working a scene; never copy full narration, design intents or whole plans into each handoff; read canonical source when modifying and do not skip any manifest gates. After Visual Compile, run orchestration/audit-creative-reuse.mjs for repetition review. Never force new SVG or silently block legitimate same-character/same-setting continuity.
